test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some blue are red.

II. Some green are red.

**Conclusions:**

I. No blue is green.

II. No red is green.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is given below:

Statements:

I. Some blue are red.

II. Some green are red.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bffbb39d2338fa71d5feeeed9b243ade0dfc162b645c5f736f769ea58837421e.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No blue is green → **Does not follow **→ There is no direct relation between blue and green. So it is possible but not definitely true.

II. No red is green → Does not follow → As some green are red. So no red is green is definitely not follow.

So, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
